title: How El Chapo Ended Up in a Brooklyn Courtroom

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 新《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在nytimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: After months of anticipation, the trial of legendary Mexican drug lord, El Chapo, is finally underway.
sentences.zh: 经过数月的期待，传说中的墨西哥毒枭“矮子”古斯曼的审判终于开始了。

sentences.en: The story of why it took so long to get to this day.
sentences.zh: 讲述为什么走到这一天花了这么久的故事。

sentences.en: November 19th.
It's now about 6.15 on Tuesday, November 13th, and I am sitting outside the federal district court in
sentences.zh: 现在是11月13日星期二大约6点15分，我正坐在布鲁克林联邦地区法院外面，

sentences.en: Brooklyn where I just arrived for the first day of the El Chapo trial.
sentences.zh: 我刚到那里参加“矮子”审判的第一天。

sentences.en: Alan, set the scene for me on the first day of the El Chapo trial.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，给我讲讲“矮子”审判第一天的现场情景。

sentences.en: What's the feeling like in that courtroom?
sentences.zh: 法庭里的气氛是怎样的？

sentences.en: There's a real electricity.
sentences.zh: 有一种真实的电击般的感觉。

sentences.en: We're on the eighth floor of the Brooklyn Federal Courthouse, and it's actually a really small room.
sentences.zh: 我们在布鲁克林联邦法院的八楼，这其实是一个非常小的房间。

sentences.en: The press is in the front row on the right, directly across on the left, government officials.
sentences.zh: 媒体坐在右侧的第一排，正对面左侧是政府官员。

sentences.en: El Chapo's wife, generally dressed in black, often wearing very heavy perfume, sits directly behind the first press row.
sentences.zh: “矮子”的妻子通常身穿黑衣，经常喷很浓的香水，坐在媒体第一排的正后方。

sentences.en: You can smell it.
sentences.zh: 你能闻到它。

sentences.en: You can smell it.
sentences.zh: 你能闻到它。

sentences.en: And there is intense security in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 法庭内的安保非常森严。

sentences.en: There must be a dozen armed federal marshals.
sentences.zh: 一定有十多名武装联邦法警。

sentences.en: The prosecution team is enormous.
sentences.zh: 控方团队非常庞大。

sentences.en: The defense team is smaller, but they're shrewd.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队规模较小，但他们很精明。

sentences.en: Three main lawyers running the case.
sentences.zh: 有三名主要律师负责这个案子。

sentences.en: The moment that everybody waits for is when the door inside the well of the court opens.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在等待的时刻是法庭正下方的门打开的时候。

sentences.en: Three marshals go in, and out they come with El Chapo.
sentences.zh: 三名法警走了进去，带着“矮子”出来了。

sentences.en: He comes out from the back, finds his wife, Emma Coronella Sparrow.
sentences.zh: 他从后面出来，找到了他的妻子埃玛·科罗内拉·斯帕罗。

sentences.en: He gives her a brief wave.
sentences.zh: 他向她简短地挥了挥手。

sentences.en: He sits.
sentences.zh: 他坐下了。

sentences.en: The judge arrives.
sentences.zh: 法官到了。

sentences.en: And, you know, for all of us who have been following this case for going on what is now two years, that first day was really the moment that we had been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，对于我们这些已经关注这个案子快两年的人来说，第一天确实是我们一直期待的时刻。

sentences.en: Alan Foyer has been covering the trial for The Times.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·福耶尔一直在为《时报》报道这场审判。

sentences.en: The big picture importance of this case is that we have never had a major Mexican drug kingpin in an American courtroom before.
sentences.zh: 这个案子的宏观重要性在于，我们以前从未在美式法庭上见过重量级的墨西哥毒枭。

sentences.en: People get arrested in Mexico, get extradited to the United States, and then they plead guilty.
sentences.zh: 人们在墨西哥被捕，被引渡到美国，然后他们认罪。

sentences.en: They become cooperating witnesses, some of them.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人成为了合作证人。

sentences.en: This is the first time that a major figure in the Mexican drug world has decided to gut it out and go to trial.
sentences.zh: 这是墨西哥毒品世界的重要人物第一次决定硬扛到底并接受审判。

sentences.en: In the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 在美国？

sentences.en: In the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国。

sentences.en: And so what that means is that American prosecutors, the people in Brooklyn, people in other judicial districts around the country,
sentences.zh: 这意味着美国检察官，布鲁克林的人，全国其他司法管辖区的人，

sentences.en: have been amassing boatloads of information on Chapo and on the Sinaloa cartel for years.
sentences.zh: 多年来一直在积累关于古斯曼和锡那罗亚贩毒集团的大量信息。

sentences.en: And this is the first time that they're essentially going to show us their hand and lay out everything that they have on this guy.
sentences.zh: 这是他们基本上第一次向我们亮出底牌，摆出他们掌握这个家伙的所有证据。

sentences.en: And let's just go back a little bit here.
sentences.zh: 让我们在这里稍微倒回一点。

sentences.en: What did we know about El Chapo before this trial began?
sentences.zh: 在审判开始之前，我们对“矮子”了解多少？

sentences.en: El Chapo was born in the town of La Tuna, which is in rural Sinaloa state.
sentences.zh: “矮子”出生在拉图纳镇，位于锡那罗亚州的农村地区。

sentences.en: And he grew up in the countryside, poor, to the point where as a young teenager,
sentences.zh: 他在乡村长大，很穷，以至于在十几岁的时候，

sentences.en: he would go around and sell oranges and bread and cheese to the neighbors in order to feed his family.
sentences.zh: 他会四处向邻居出售橙子、面包和奶酪来养活家人。

sentences.en: Now, he also happened to be selling something else at that point, even at the age of 15.
sentences.zh: 现在，碰巧的是，他在那个时候也在卖别的东西，甚至在15岁的时候。

sentences.en: He was growing pot, selling it, growing poppies and selling them.
sentences.zh: 他在种大麻并出售，种罂粟并出售。

sentences.en: And over the years, he developed a reputation as being a shrewd, fast and efficient smuggler.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他树立了精明、迅速和高效的走私者的名声。

sentences.en: He worked first as the kind of like sneaky expert for the Colombian cartels who would get their cocaine across the United States border.
sentences.zh: 他最初是哥伦比亚贩毒集团的狡猾专家，负责将他们的可卡因运送过美国边境。

sentences.en: And he was innovative.
sentences.zh: 而且他很有创新精神。

sentences.en: He was kind of revolutionary in tunnels.
sentences.zh: 他在地道方面可以说是革命性的。

sentences.en: That was his big thing, tunnels.
sentences.zh: 那是他的拿手好戏，地道。

sentences.en: He was a master tunnel builder.
sentences.zh: 他是建造地道的专家。

sentences.en: And so he's working for the Colombians for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 所以他为哥伦比亚人工作了相当长的一段时间。

sentences.en: And he's helping them get their drugs through Mexico to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他帮他们把毒品通过墨西哥运往美国。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he's so fast that his first nickname is not El Chapo, which means shorty because he's kind of a short guy.
sentences.zh: 他速度太快了，以至于他的第一个绰号不是El Chapo（意为矮子，因为他有点矮）。

sentences.en: His first nickname is El Rapido.
sentences.zh: 他的第一个绰号是El Rapido（快手）。

sentences.en: But then something happens.
sentences.zh: 但随后发生了某些事情。

sentences.en: The Colombian government starts to crack down on the Colombian cartels, which kind of signals the end of the Pablo Escobar Colombian period.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚政府开始打击哥伦比亚贩毒集团，这可以说是巴勃罗·埃斯科瓦尔哥伦比亚时期的结束标志。

sentences.en: And into that vacuum steps El Chapo.
sentences.zh: 而“矮子”则填补了这一真空。

sentences.en: At that point, he has collected around him a loose band of criminal allies, some of them his own relatives.
sentences.zh: 当时，他在身边聚集了一群松散的犯罪盟友，其中一些是他的亲戚。

sentences.en: And not surprisingly, this prompts an enormous amount of jealousy amongst other drug traffickers in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 毫不奇怪，这激起了墨西哥其他毒贩的大量嫉妒。

sentences.en: And Chapo starts developing very serious rivals.
sentences.zh: 古斯曼开始树立非常厉害的对手。

sentences.en: And so it is that jealousy that is ultimately the source of what we know today of Mexico's drug wars.
sentences.zh: 因此，正是这种嫉妒最终成为了我们今天所知的墨西哥毒品战争的源头。

sentences.en: For example, 1992, Chapo, in an attempt to eliminate one of these rivals that he's collected, sends an armed band of assassins into a nightclub in Puerto Vallarta.
sentences.zh: 例如，1992年，“矮子”为了消灭他结下的这些对手之一，派遣了一支武装刺客小队前往巴亚尔塔港的一家夜总会。

sentences.en: And they essentially shoot the place up.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上把那个地方扫射了一番。

sentences.en: They miss their intended target.
sentences.zh: 他们打错了目标。

sentences.en: But that gunfight sets off this cycle of increasing violence.
sentences.zh: 但那场枪战引发了不断升级的暴力循环。

sentences.en: There are revenge shootouts.
sentences.zh: 有复仇枪战。

sentences.en: There are revenge, revenge shootouts.
sentences.zh: 有复仇的复仇枪战。

sentences.en: But it all kind of comes to a head and really, really rips into Mexico's collective psyche in 1993 when a high ranking official of Mexico's Roman Catholic Church, a cardinal,
sentences.zh: 但这一切在1993年达到了顶峰，并真正重创了墨西哥的集体心理，当时墨西哥罗马天主教会的一位高级官员，一位红衣主教，

sentences.en: gets assassinated in what's ultimately said to be a drug war hit.
sentences.zh: 在据说是毒品战争暗杀中被暗杀。

sentences.en: And he's not supposed to have been the target.
sentences.zh: 而他本不应该是目标。

sentences.en: The real target was supposed to have been El Chapo.
sentences.zh: 真正的目标本应该是“矮子”。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So this is the moment when the Mexican public really meets El Chapo.
sentences.zh: 所以这是墨西哥公众真正认识“矮子”的时刻。

sentences.en: Yes, because in a twist of irony, the assassination gets blamed on El Chapo.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为具有讽刺意味的是，暗杀事件被归咎于“矮子”。

sentences.en: Even though he's the target.
sentences.zh: 尽管他才是目标。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Mexican government essentially undertakes a massive manhunt for El Chapo.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥政府基本上对“矮子”展开了大规模搜捕。

sentences.en: His face is in the papers, his face is on television.
sentences.zh: 他的脸上了报纸，他的脸上了电视。

sentences.en: El Chapo Guzman fue retirado del lugar.
sentences.zh: 古斯曼被带离了现场。

sentences.en: They want him badly.
sentences.zh: 他们急切地想要抓他。

sentences.en: He escapes and flees to Guatemala.
sentences.zh: 他逃跑并逃往危地马拉。

sentences.en: But the Guatemalan authorities ultimately capture him, send him back to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 但危地马拉当局最终抓获了他，把他送回了墨西哥。

sentences.en: He's put on trial in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他在墨西哥受审。

sentences.en: He's convicted in Mexico of drug and murder charges in 1993.
sentences.zh: 他于1993年在墨西哥被判犯有毒品和谋杀罪。

sentences.en: And he winds up in prison.
sentences.zh: 他最终进了监狱。

sentences.en: And El Chapo's prison life, says the lawyer, was the stuff of legend.
sentences.zh: 律师说，“矮子”的狱中生活简直是传奇。

sentences.en: El Chapo hosted a New Year's Eve party with another cartel boss.
sentences.zh: “矮子”与另一个贩毒集团头目一起举办了跨年派对。

sentences.en: There was a band playing, there were ladies, there was alcohol.
sentences.zh: 有乐队在演奏，有女士，有酒精。

sentences.en: All the best brands, Ortega told me.
sentences.zh: 奥尔特加告诉我，全都是最好的品牌。

sentences.en: It was like a party in one of the best clubs in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 这就像曼哈顿最好的一家俱乐部里的派对一样。

sentences.en: He's more or less on ice in prison for the next seven, eight years.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的七八年里，他在监狱里基本上处于被冷落的状态。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但随后……

sentences.en: El reo se escondió en un carro de lavandería.
sentences.zh: 囚犯躲在洗衣车里。

sentences.en: Nadie lo revisó.
sentences.zh: 没有人检查他。

sentences.en: He breaks out of prison in 2001.
sentences.zh: 他在2001年越狱。

sentences.en: Pasaron por el puesto de vigilancia de las oficinas administrativas...
sentences.zh: 他们经过了行政办公室的岗哨……

sentences.en: And he does so hidden inside a laundry cart with the help of a correctional officer inside the prison itself.
sentences.zh: 在监狱内部惩教人员的帮助下，他藏在一个洗衣车里逃走了。

sentences.en: He goes into immediate hiding because the Mexican authorities are just going bananas looking for him.
sentences.zh: 他立即隐蔽起来，因为墨西哥当局正发疯似地找他。

sentences.en: The search is on in earnest for Mexico's public enemy number one in the drag trade.
sentences.zh: 搜捕墨西哥贩毒界公敌头号通缉犯的工作正在认真展开。

sentences.en: He's part CEO and frankly part Scarface.
sentences.zh: 他部分是首席执行官，坦率地说部分是疤面煞星。

sentences.en: A billionaire gangster with a booming business right here in America.
sentences.zh: 一个身家亿万的匪徒，在美国本土有着蓬勃发展的业务。

sentences.en: His face is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他的脸无处不在。

sentences.en: But finding him has been just about impossible.
sentences.zh: 但找到他几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: His partner, Mayo Zambada, and Mayo Zambada's brother arrange for a helicopter to swoop down into this kind of rural area where he's been immediately hiding.
sentences.zh: 他的合伙人马约·赞巴达和马约·赞巴达的兄弟安排了一架直升机，直奔他刚刚藏身的这个乡村地区。

sentences.en: Like, get off the streets, get out of sight.
sentences.zh: 就像，离开街道，避开视线。

sentences.en: And the helicopter swoops down, takes Chapo.
sentences.zh: 直升机俯冲而下，带走了古斯曼。

sentences.en: And when the coast is more or less clear, these two brothers put Chapo into a car and they drive him into the heart of Mexico City.
sentences.zh: 当风头差不多过去时，这两兄弟把古斯曼塞进一辆车里，开车把他送到墨西哥城的心脏地带。

sentences.en: And when they get into the city, a police squad car and a police motorcycle approach them in their car and he starts to freak out.
sentences.zh: 当他们进入城市时，一辆警察巡逻车和一辆警察摩托车在他们的车旁靠近，他开始惊慌失措。

sentences.en: And one of the dudes who helped him get out says, no, no, no, no, no, Chapo, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 其中一个帮他逃跑的家伙说，不，不，不，不，不，“矮子”，别担心。

sentences.en: These are our guys.
sentences.zh: 这些是自己人。

sentences.en: They're here to protect us.
sentences.zh: 他们是来保护我们的。

sentences.en: And the cops escort him through Mexico City to a safe house.
sentences.zh: 警察护送他穿过墨西哥城来到一个安全屋。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Nuts.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: They have bought off some part of the police force.
sentences.zh: 他们收买了一部分警察力量。

sentences.en: It's astonishing.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: And what's happened to the Sinaloa cartel while El Chapo has been in prison?
sentences.zh: 在“矮子”入狱期间，锡那罗亚贩毒集团发生了什么？

sentences.en: It sounds from his escape that it's made meaningful inroads inside the Mexican government.
sentences.zh: 从他的越狱听起来，它已经在墨西哥政府内部取得了实质性进展。

sentences.en: It's growing.
sentences.zh: 它在成长。

sentences.en: Welcome now to Gangster's Paradise, where the Sinaloa cartel rules.
sentences.zh: 现在欢迎来到强盗乐园，锡那罗亚贩毒集团统治的地方。

sentences.en: This is one of the most dangerous spots in Mexico, a place where few outsiders go.
sentences.zh: 这是墨西哥最危险的地方之一，一个很少有外人去的地方。

sentences.en: It's expanding internationally.
sentences.zh: 它正在向国际扩展。

sentences.en: Guzman's Sinaloa cartel is worth a giant $3 billion and controls nearly half of the illegal drugs funneled into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 古斯曼的锡那罗亚贩毒集团价值高达30亿美元，控制了流入美国近一半的非法毒品。

sentences.en: A U.S.
sentences.zh: 一名美国

sentences.en: official says Guzman's Sinaloa cartel has huge markets in Chicago, has a foothold in Los Angeles, a large network in Phoenix and throughout the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 官员称，古斯曼的锡那罗亚贩毒集团在芝加哥拥有巨大的市场，在洛杉矶有立足点，在菲尼克斯和整个中西部拥有庞大的网络。

sentences.en: Officials say his Sinaloa cartel is the number one supplier of heroin, cocaine and marijuana to the United States.
sentences.zh: 官员称他的锡那罗亚贩毒集团是美国海洛因、可卡因和大麻的第一大供应商。

sentences.en: And at the same time, the violence is expanding wildly, too.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，暴力活动也在疯狂地蔓延。

sentences.en: Ten months ago, this mutilated body appeared outside a Mexican police station.
sentences.zh: 十个月前，这具肢解的尸体出现在墨西哥警察局外。

sentences.en: The message hanging over his corpse signed in El Chapo's name.
sentences.zh: 悬挂在他尸体上方的信息是用“矮子”的名字签署的。

sentences.en: Violent scenes like these, bodies stuffed in garbage bags, police executed, and journalists assassinated, are directly connected to the wrath of a Sinaloa cartel.
sentences.zh: 像这样的暴力场景，塞满垃圾袋的尸体、被处决的警察和被暗杀的记者，都与锡那罗亚贩毒集团的愤怒直接相关。

sentences.en: So vicious, nearly 80,000 people have died in Mexico from drug violence.
sentences.zh: 太残忍了，墨西哥近8万死于毒品暴力。

sentences.en: You not only have bodies stacking up literally in the streets in Mexico, but you also have people in the United States who are dying from using these drugs.
sentences.zh: 不仅墨西哥街头横尸遍野，美国也有人因吸食这些毒品而死。

sentences.en: In fact, Chapo himself was named as public enemy number one by the Chicago Crime Commission.
sentences.zh: 事实上，“矮子”本人被芝加哥犯罪委员会命名为头号公敌。

sentences.en: The last time they did that, it involved a guy named Al Capone.
sentences.zh: 他们上一次这么做，涉及一个名叫阿尔·卡彭的人。

sentences.en: And essentially, by 2014, it is the biggest, most profitable drug cartel in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 基本上，到2014年，它是墨西哥最大、最赚钱的贩毒集团。

sentences.en: And throughout this time, what is El Chapo's relationship like to the Mexican government and to the people of Mexico?
sentences.zh: 在这期间，“矮子”与墨西哥政府以及墨西哥人民的关系是怎样的？

sentences.en: To the people of Mexico, he's a folk hero.
sentences.zh: 对墨西哥人民来说，他是个民间英雄。

sentences.en: He's a modern-day Robin Hood.
sentences.zh: 他是当代的罗宾汉。

sentences.en: Every time he outsmarts the government,
sentences.zh: 每当他智胜政府时，

sentences.en: the people root for him because there's always been a fraught relationship in Mexico between the people and their government whom they don't really truSt.
sentences.zh: 人们都会为他加油，因为墨西哥民众和他们并不真正信任的政府之间一直存在着紧张的关系。

sentences.en: So to watch on the most public stage possible this outlaw hero get one over on the government again and again and again, I just think that people really like that.
sentences.zh: 所以，看着这个无法无天的英雄在万众瞩目的舞台上一次又一次地戏耍政府，我只是觉得人们真的很喜欢这样。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: and Mexican authorities are hailing the capture today of the most notorious drug trafficker in the world.
sentences.zh: 和墨西哥当局今天对抓获全球最臭名昭著的毒枭表示赞赏。

sentences.en: Joaquin Guzman, known as El Chapo, was caught after eluding authorities for 13 years.
sentences.zh: 华金·古斯曼，人称“矮子”，在逃亡13年后落网。

sentences.en: And sure enough, the next time that the Mexican government does capture El Chapo, they can't even keep him in prison for a year.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，下一次墨西哥政府抓获“矮子”时，他们甚至连一年都关不住他。

sentences.en: And back to our breaking story, a killer kingpin whose cartel has drug runners operating right here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 回到我们的突发新闻，一个其贩毒集团甚至在美国境内就有运毒人员的杀人巨鳄

sentences.en: is now on the loose.
sentences.zh: 现在又逍遥法外了。

sentences.en: A manhunt happening right now for this man, El Chapo.
sentences.zh: 目前正在对这个人——“矮子”进行大搜捕。

sentences.en: And we're learning new details this morning about the prison escape of notorious drug kingpin Joaquin El Chapo Guzman.
sentences.zh: 今天早晨，我们获悉了关于大毒枭华金·“矮子”·古斯曼越狱的新细节。

sentences.en: Mexican authorities have released new video that appears to show the moment Guzman vanishing from his cell in the maximum security prison.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥当局发布了新视频，似乎显示了古斯曼从最高安全级别监狱的牢房中消失的那一刻。

sentences.en: And that time when he breaks out, he does so in a mile-long tunnel that his associates dug into the shower of his cell in prison.
sentences.zh: 而当他越狱时，他是通过一条他的同伙在监狱牢房淋浴间里挖出来的长达一英里的地道逃跑的。

sentences.en: Pay close attention to this video.
sentences.zh: 请密切注意这段视频。

sentences.en: Mexican authorities have just released this closed-circuit video from inside the prison showing Joaquin El Chapo Guzman in the final moments before he broke out.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥当局刚刚发布了来自监狱内部的闭路监控视频，展示了华金·“矮子”·古斯曼越狱前最后的时刻。

sentences.en: There's video of it in the prison of him going down into the little, like, tunnel hole.
sentences.zh: 有监狱里的视频显示他走进了那个小小的、类似地道的洞里。

sentences.en: And then he goes around where the toilet is, and you see the dramatic moment.
sentences.zh: 然后他绕到马桶所在的地方，你看到了戏剧性的时刻。

sentences.en: There it is right there where El Chapo disappears into the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 就是那里，“矮子”消失在地道里。

sentences.en: There he is.
sentences.zh: 他就在那儿。

sentences.en: Now he's gone.
sentences.zh: 现在他不见了。

sentences.en: And waiting for him at the bottom of the tunnel is a motorcycle, and he just, like, rides to safety.
sentences.zh: 地道底部有一辆摩托车在等着他，他就这样骑车安全离开了。

sentences.en: The tunnel runs nearly a full mile from under the prison to a house.
sentences.zh: 这条地道从监狱下方一直延伸到一栋房子，长达近整整一英里。

sentences.en: And here it is.
sentences.zh: 就是这里。

sentences.en: This is the house where he just walked into and disappeared.
sentences.zh: 这就是他走进去并消失的那栋房子。

sentences.en: That one was unfathomable.
sentences.zh: 那个真是令人匪夷所思。

sentences.en: The shockwaves of El Chapo's escape felt in Mexico and here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: “矮子”越狱的冲击波在墨西哥和美国都有所感知。

sentences.en: The escape of Chapo Guzman translates into two things.
sentences.zh: 古斯曼的越狱意味着两件事。

sentences.en: More violence for Mexico and more drugs coming into the United States.
sentences.zh: 给墨西哥带来更多暴力，向美国输送更多毒品。

sentences.en: It takes another year before they finally re-re-capture him?
sentences.zh: 他们花了一年时间才最终再次重新抓获他？

sentences.en: How many re's are we at?
sentences.zh: 我们用到第几个“重新”了？

sentences.en: The Mexican attorney general revealing that the drug kingpin was trying to make a movie about himself and had his people contact producers and actors.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥总检察长透露，这名大毒枭曾试图拍一部关于他自己的电影，并派人联系了制作人和演员。

sentences.en: At least one source says their movements were tracked.
sentences.zh: 至少有一个消息来源称他们的行踪被追踪了。

sentences.en: They capture him again in 2016, and it's really at that point that the American government's like, guys, enough's enough.
sentences.zh: 他们在2016年再次抓获了他，也正是在那个时候，美国政府的态度是，伙计们，够了。

sentences.en: And a long extradition process finally begins.
sentences.zh: 漫长的引渡程序终于开始了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: What role is the United States government playing at this point in trying to bring El Chapo to justice?
sentences.zh: 在这个时候，美国政府在将“矮子”绳之以法方面发挥了什么作用？

sentences.en: Well, today we are announcing in a coordinated action major drug trafficking charges against 43 individuals, including cartel leaders.
sentences.zh: 嗯，今天我们在一项联合行动中宣布对43名个人（包括贩毒集团头目）提出重大贩毒指控。

sentences.en: He was already, at that point, under indictment in six different federal judicial districts in the United States.
sentences.zh: 当时，他已经在美国的六个不同联邦司法区遭到起诉。

sentences.en: We allege that these defendants shipped multi-ton quantities of narcotics into the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们指控这些被告向美国运送了多吨毒品。

sentences.en: There was Brooklyn, there was Miami, there was Chicago, there was El Paso.
sentences.zh: 有布鲁克林，有迈阿密，有芝加哥，有埃尔帕索。

sentences.en: So the United States government wanted this guy.
sentences.zh: 所以美国政府想要这个人。

sentences.en: The indictments unsealed today outline nearly two decades of criminal activity by these cartels and their leaders here in the United States, as well as Mexico and other countries.
sentences.zh: 今天启封的起诉书概述了这些贩毒集团及其头目在美国、墨西哥和其他国家近二十年的犯罪活动。

sentences.en: And what were the charges for?
sentences.zh: 指控的罪名是什么？

sentences.en: Massive drug conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 大规模毒品阴谋。

sentences.en: So obviously part of it was the drugs.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，其中一部分是关于毒品的。

sentences.en: But it was also a sense that the Mexican government was sort of unable to keep this guy under wraps.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一种感觉，即墨西哥政府有点无力管束这家伙。

sentences.en: And if Mexico couldn't do it, the United States government would.
sentences.zh: 如果墨西哥做不到，美国政府就会出手。

sentences.en: There is breaking news tonight from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 今晚来自墨西哥有突发新闻。

sentences.en: Infamous drug lord Joaquin El Chapo Guzman is being extradited to face charges in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 臭名昭著的毒枭华金·“矮子”·古斯曼正被引渡到美国接受审判。

sentences.en: They put him, Chapo, on a Mexican police jet in Ciudad Juarez.
sentences.zh: 他们把“矮子”塞进了华雷斯城的一架墨西哥警察喷气机里。

sentences.en: And they start to fly him to an airport in Long Island.
sentences.zh: 他们开始用飞机把他运往长岛的一个机场。

sentences.en: And Chapo actually, at this point, has no idea where he's going.
sentences.zh: 而此时此刻，“矮子”其实根本不知道自己要去哪里。

sentences.en: He thinks that he's being transferred to yet another Mexican prison.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己正被转移到另一个墨西哥监狱。

sentences.en: And it's not until the plane starts landing at MacArthur Airport in Long Island that he looks out the window, sees an unfamiliar airport.
sentences.zh: 直到飞机开始降落在长岛的麦克阿瑟机场，他看着窗外，看到了一个不认识的机场。

sentences.en: And he turns to the agents on the plane with him and he's like, where am I being taken?
sentences.zh: 他转向和他同机的特工说，我这是被带到哪儿去了？

sentences.en: And one of these guys says to him in Spanish, bienvenido on New York.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人用西班牙语对他说，欢迎来到纽约。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And I guess this is the inevitable question.
sentences.zh: 我想这是不可避免的问题。

sentences.en: Where is he housed?
sentences.zh: 他被关在哪里？

sentences.en: And is it secure?
sentences.zh: 安全吗？

sentences.en: Well, given his prior proclivities, they place Chapo in what's called 10 South, the maximum security wing of the federal jail in lower Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他先前的嗜好，他们把“矮子”安置在所谓的“南10区”，即曼哈顿下城联邦监狱的最高安全级别侧翼。

sentences.en: And he is held under lock and key 23 hours a day under the most severe conditions of confinement that you could possibly imagine.
sentences.zh: 他每天23小时被锁在门后，处于你能想象到的最严酷的关押条件下。

sentences.en: And he is permitted out only to go to court.
sentences.zh: 他只被允许出去上庭。

sentences.en: And even then, when he's brought to court, the court, of course, is in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，当他被带去出庭时，法庭当然是在布鲁克林。

sentences.en: The jail is in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 监狱在曼哈顿。

sentences.en: And the quickest route from one to the other is to travel across the Brooklyn Bridge.
sentences.zh: 从一个地方到另一个地方的最快路线是穿过布鲁克林大桥。

sentences.en: So Chapo is traveling across the Brooklyn Bridge in a motorcade of armed vehicles and police escorts.
sentences.zh: 因此，“矮子”正坐在一支由装甲车辆和警察护送的车队中穿过布鲁克林大桥。

sentences.en: But to be super secure, the police shut the entire Brooklyn Bridge down every time he crosses and every time he goes back.
sentences.zh: 但为了绝对安全，每次他过桥和每次他返回时，警方都会将整座布鲁克林大桥封锁。

sentences.en: And what kind of vehicle does he travel in?
sentences.zh: 他乘坐的是什么交通工具？

sentences.en: He's inside of an armored van of some sort.
sentences.zh: 他坐在一辆某种装甲面包车里。

sentences.en: And he's in some sort of, like, coffin-like thing so that there's, like, two layers of security.
sentences.zh: 他身处某种类似棺材的容器里，这样就有两层安全保障。

sentences.en: So I know this area of lower Manhattan and of Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 所以，我了解曼哈顿下城和布鲁克林的这个区域。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The distance is maybe a mile between that prison and the courthouse in downtown Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 从那座监狱到布鲁克林市中心的法院，距离可能有一英里。

sentences.en: What are they worried is going to happen in this span?
sentences.zh: 他们担心在这段路程中会发生什么？

sentences.en: On the journey across the bridge?
sentences.zh: 在过桥的旅程中？

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, they're worried that the cartel is, like, going to fly a helicopter and try and, like, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很显然，他们担心贩毒集团会开直升机，试图，你知道的，

sentences.en: stop the caravan in which he's traveling and ferry him to safety.
sentences.zh: 拦截他乘坐的车队并把他营救到安全地带。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Anything is possible.
sentences.zh: 一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: Anything is possible.
sentences.zh: 一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: There was one time this guy escaped through a hatch that was hidden under his bathtub.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，这家伙通过藏在他浴缸底部的舱口逃跑了。

sentences.en: And the bathtub came off the ground on a hydraulic lift.
sentences.zh: 浴缸在液压升降机上脱离地面。

sentences.en: And underneath the bathtub was a maze of tunnels that led into the sewer system.
sentences.zh: 浴缸下面是一个通往排污系统的迷宫般的地道。

sentences.en: So I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道。

sentences.en: What has been built under the Brooklyn Bridge in the last three or four years is, I guess, the question.
sentences.zh: 我想问题是，在过去三四年里，布鲁克林大桥下面修建了什么。

sentences.en: I guess so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: El Chapo on trial.
sentences.zh: “矮子”受审。

sentences.en: The notorious drug boss faces judgment in a New York courtroom.
sentences.zh: 这个臭名昭著的毒枭在纽约法庭上面临审判。

sentences.en: The unprecedented security today and the secrecy surrounding the case.
sentences.zh: 今天的空前安保以及围绕该案的保密工作。

sentences.en: And so finally, after this long process, what's now been almost two years, last Tuesday, the trial finally started.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，经过这个漫长的过程，几乎快过去两年了，上周二，审判终于开始了。

sentences.en: Prosecutors told the jury that he had essentially carved out a narcotics empire,
sentences.zh: 检察官告诉陪审团，他基本上开创了一个毒品帝国，

sentences.en: running his own private army and having his own personal arsenal that included a diamond encrusted handgun and a gold plated AK-47.
sentences.zh: 经营着自己的私人军队，并拥有自己的个人军火库，其中包括一把镶钻手枪和一把镀金AK-47。

sentences.en: Alan, what struck you the most about the first week of this trial?
sentences.zh: 艾伦，这次审判的第一周最让你震惊的是什么？

sentences.en: What's most amazing to me is that after having just read stuff, court documents, trial transcripts,
sentences.zh: 最让我惊叹的是，在刚刚阅读了各种材料、法庭文件、庭审记录之后，

sentences.en: now these people are like stepping off the page and coming to life in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 现在这些人就像是从纸面上走下来，在法庭上活了过来。

sentences.en: And so, you know, the first major witness is a guy who was one of Chapo's close allies and kind of operational chiefs for a long time.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，第一个主要证人是一个长期担任“矮子”亲密盟友和作战长官之一的家伙。

sentences.en: He ran Mexico City for the cartel.
sentences.zh: 他为贩毒集团掌管墨西哥城。

sentences.en: And he's just been a tour guide to the inner workings of the cartel and has kind of just been giving a master class in how the whole operation works.
sentences.zh: 他简直就是贩毒集团内部运作的导游，就像是在上一堂关于整个运作机制的大师课。

sentences.en: And what have you learned from him?
sentences.zh: 你从他身上学到了什么？

sentences.en: We've learned from him everything from transportation methods to capital financing to how the cartel is structured to who the chief players in the cartel are.
sentences.zh: 我们从他那里了解了一切，从运输方式到资本融资，再到贩毒集团的结构，以及贩毒集团中的核心人物是谁。

sentences.en: One of the most amazing things was this guy explained in the most financially savvy terms that a $9 million investment and a 15 ton shipment of Colombian cocaine will,
sentences.zh: 最惊人的事情之一是，这家伙用最精明的财务术语解释了9百万美元的投资和15吨哥伦比亚可卡因，

sentences.en: if the cartel manages to get it and sell it in Los Angeles, net, I want to say, what was it?
sentences.zh: 如果贩毒集团设法将其运到洛杉矶并售出，净利润，我想说，是多少来着？

sentences.en: $39 million.
Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's a $30 million profit.
sentences.zh: 那是3000万美元的利润。

sentences.en: That's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 那是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: But if the same shipment is smuggled into and sold in Chicago, where prices are higher, it was a $48 million profit.
sentences.zh: 但如果同样的货物被走私并出售到价格更高的芝加哥，利润就是4800万美元。

sentences.en: And finally, if the same shipment made it to New York, $78 million.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果同样的货物运抵纽约，则是7800万美元。

sentences.en: Sheesh, we overpay.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我们付多了。

sentences.en: But that's not a surprise if you live in New York.
sentences.zh: 但如果你住在纽约，这并不奇怪。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Who else is slated to testify in the next few weeks?
sentences.zh: 接下来几周还有谁预定要出庭作证？

sentences.en: Well, that is secret.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是保密的。

sentences.en: The government, because of all these security precautions, has been very tight-lipped.
sentences.zh: 由于所有这些安保防范措施，政府一直守口如瓶。

sentences.en: What we do know is that at least 16 cooperating witnesses, including the guy who's on the witness stand now, will ultimately show up.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道，至少有16名合作证人（包括现在正站在证人席上的那个家伙）最终都会出面。

sentences.en: And public court documents have given us a couple of hints as to who those may be.
sentences.zh: 公开的法庭文件为我们提供了一些线索，让我们知道那些人可能是谁。

sentences.en: It may be that the guy who helped him escape from prison in the laundry cart is going to show up.
sentences.zh: 可能是那个用洗衣车帮他越狱的家伙会出场。

sentences.en: And a couple of his Colombian suppliers might show up and other cartel figures.
sentences.zh: 他的几个哥伦比亚供应商可能会出场，还有其他贩毒集团的人物。

sentences.en: But it's not 100% clear yet.
sentences.zh: 但目前还不是百分之百清楚。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And from everything you've told us so far, what could his defense possibly be?
sentences.zh: 根据你目前告诉我们的一切，他的辩护究竟会是什么？

sentences.en: I wondered that myself for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我自己也纳闷了很久。

sentences.en: He's kind of a defense lawyer's nightmare.
sentences.zh: 他简直是辩护律师的噩梦。

sentences.en: But the defense offered a very surprising opening statement in which they claimed that Chapo was actually not the real leader of the Sinaloa drug cartel and had been framed for years by a vast conspiracy that included his former partner,
sentences.zh: 但辩护方发表了一份非常令人惊奇的开场陈述，他们声称“矮子”实际上并非锡那罗亚贩毒集团的真正头目，多年来一直被一个巨大的阴谋陷害，这个阴谋包括他的前合伙人、

sentences.en: crooked American drug agents, and the Mexican government itself.
sentences.zh: 腐败的美国缉毒特工以及墨西哥政府本身。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So he's just a bag man who's been elevated to the top in the telling of others.
sentences.zh: 所以在别人的讲述中，他只是一个被推到高位的运钞员。

sentences.en: He is, according to the defense, a scapegoat and nothing more.
sentences.zh: 用辩护方的话说，他只是一个替罪羊，仅此而已。

sentences.en: Based on everything that you've described, it sounds like the evidence against El Chapo is significant and that a verdict is more or less guaranteed to be guilty.
sentences.zh: 基于你所描述的一切，听起来针对“矮子”的证据确凿，罪名基本可以说是板上钉钉。

sentences.en: Correct me if I'm wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果我错了请纠正我。

sentences.en: So with that in mind, what is this trial really about?
sentences.zh: 带着这个想法，这次审判到底是为了什么？

sentences.en: There's an interesting correlative to the mob, right?
sentences.zh: 这与黑手党有一个有趣的相似之处，对吧？

sentences.en: So in the 50s, when a gangster got asked, you know, if the mafia existed, they would just deny it.
sentences.zh: 所以在50年代，当有人问一个歹徒黑手党是否存在时，他们只会否认。

sentences.en: There's no mafia.
sentences.zh: 没有什么黑手党。

sentences.en: What are you talking about?
sentences.zh: 你在说什么？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: And then a guy named Joe Valacci, who was in the mob, got called to Congress and he had to testify.
sentences.zh: 然后一个名叫乔·瓦拉奇的黑手党成员被传唤到国会，他不得不作证。

sentences.en: And it was the first time that someone from inside La Cosa Nostra went on the record and said, not only does this thing exist, but here's how it works.
sentences.zh: 这是来自“我们的事业”内部的人首次公开表示，这东西不仅存在，而且运作方式是这样的。

sentences.en: Here's its bylaws and its culture and its chief players.
sentences.zh: 这里是它的章程、文化和核心人物。

sentences.en: And that's kind of exactly what's going on now with the Chapo trial and the cartels.
sentences.zh: 这正是目前“矮子”审判和各大贩毒集团案件中所发生的情况。

sentences.en: This is the first public unfolding of all of what we know about these organizations that have kind of swirled around us mythically for years.
sentences.zh: 这是我们多年来对这些如神话般萦绕在周围的组织所知的一切的首次公开披露。

sentences.en: And that would seem important on its own in the sense that we've long tried to understand the drug problem and the violence problem in the U.S., in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 就我们长期以来试图理解美国和墨西哥的毒品问题及暴力问题而言，这本身似乎就很重要。

sentences.en: And instead of throwing up our hands, a trial like this says, there's a reason why this happens.
sentences.zh: 与其束手无策，这样的审判说明：这一切发生是有原因的。

sentences.en: It has a name.
sentences.zh: 它有名字。

sentences.en: It has a face.
sentences.zh: 它有面孔。

sentences.en: It has an organizational structure.
sentences.zh: 它有组织架构。

sentences.en: Here's what it is.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的全貌。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对如此。

sentences.en: Look, in this man's wake, there's carnage.
sentences.zh: 听着，在这个人身后，是一片血流成河。

sentences.en: I mean, countless thousands, tens of thousands of people have died in Mexico over the years, you know, and maybe not just from the Sinaloa cartel,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，多年来在墨西哥有无数人、成千上万的人丧生，你知道的，也许不仅仅是因为锡那罗亚贩毒集团，

sentences.en: but through the larger cancer that are these cartels.
sentences.zh: 而是由于这些贩毒集团所形成的更大毒瘤。

sentences.en: So if and presumably when El Chapo goes away at the end of his trial and we assume he stays away for good, what happens to this cartel that he leaves behind?
sentences.zh: 因此，如果—而且大概率当“矮子”在审判结束后锒铛入狱，并且我们假设他永远不会出来时，他留下的这个贩毒集团会怎么样？

sentences.en: What does that do to the flow of drugs, especially into the United States?
sentences.zh: 这会对毒品流入量产生什么影响，尤其是流入美国的毒品？

sentences.en: The flow continues.
sentences.zh: 毒品流入仍在继续。

sentences.en: Sinaloa's new product is fentanyl, which is not only terribly lethal, but wildly popular.
sentences.zh: 锡那罗亚的新产品是芬太尼，它不仅极其致命，而且大受欢迎。

sentences.en: They've essentially started, you know, selling the next best thing.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上已经开始，你知道的，售卖次优但同样暴利的替代品。

sentences.en: Opioids.
sentences.zh: 阿片类药物。

sentences.en: Opioids.
sentences.zh: 阿片类药物。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, don't forget how Chapo himself rose to power.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，别忘了“矮子”本人是如何发迹的。

sentences.en: There was a kind of tidal shift in the cartel structure.
sentences.zh: 当时贩毒集团的结构发生了一种浪潮般的转变。

sentences.en: The Colombians receded.
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚人退居幕后。

sentences.en: Chapo emerged.
sentences.zh: “矮子”崭露头角。

sentences.en: And so in Chapo's absence, what's happened is that the Sinaloa cartel of his day has split into factions.
sentences.zh: 所以在“矮子”缺席的情况下，发生的事情是，他那个时代的锡那罗亚贩毒集团已经分裂成了各个派系。

sentences.en: His sons are running one side.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子们掌控着一方。

sentences.en: The other guy's running other sides.
sentences.zh: 另一个人掌控着其他地方。

sentences.en: And so who's to say with Chapo going away for good, should that happen, that a vacuum might open up and drug traffickers like nature abhor a vacuum?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果“矮子”永远离开，这事真发生了，谁能说不会出现权力真空，而毒贩就像自然界一样厌恶真空呢？

sentences.en: And into that space, a new Chapo could ultimately step in.
sentences.zh: 最终，一个新的“矮子”可能会步入那个真空地带。

sentences.en: Alan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Well, things worked out a little differently than Grace and I had hoped.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事情的发展跟格蕾丝和我所希望的有些不同。

sentences.en: But let me say I, by no measure, feel defeated.
sentences.zh: 但我必须说，我绝没有感到失败。

sentences.en: And that's because I've had the privilege of serving the people of Florida and our country for most of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我大半生都有幸为佛罗里达州的人民和我们的国家服务。

sentences.en: On Sunday, after a manual recount of votes in Florida, Democratic Senator Bill Nelson conceded defeat to Republican Rick Scott, giving Republicans a 52-seat majority in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 周日，在佛罗里达州人工重新计票后，民主党参议员比尔·纳尔逊向共和党人里克·斯科特承认失败，这使共和党人在参议院获得了52个席位的多数。

sentences.en: It's been a rewarding journey as well as a very humbling experience.
sentences.zh: 这是一段收获颇丰的旅程，也是一次非常令人谦卑的经历。

sentences.en: Heading into the recount, Nelson trailed Scott by about 12,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 在进入重新计票阶段之前，纳尔逊落后斯科特大约12,000票。

sentences.en: With the recount completed on Sunday, he still trailed by about 10,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 随着周日重新计票的完成，他仍然落后大约10,000票。

sentences.en: I was not victorious in this race, but I still wish to strongly reaffirm the cause for which we fought.
sentences.zh: 我在这次竞选中并没有获胜，但我仍然希望强烈重申我们为之奋斗的事业。

sentences.en: A public office is a public truSt.
sentences.zh: 公职是一项公众信托。

sentences.en: A single Senate race remains uncalled in Mississippi, where Republican Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Mike Espy will compete in a runoff on November 27th,
sentences.zh: 密西西比州还有一个参议员席位未决出胜负，共和党参议员辛迪·海德-史密斯和民主党人迈克·埃斯皮将于11月27日在决选中竞争，

sentences.en: after neither candidate won a majority of the vote on Election Day.
sentences.zh: 此前两名候选人在选举日都没有赢得多数选票。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日播客》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《连线者秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人的活动做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是遮光睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否喝断片来睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序上或在您喜欢收听的任何地方查找《连线者秀》。
